name: Tunmire
original_description:
Book formatting for self-publishing authors: Tunmire turns your manuscript into a print-ready paperback interior (PDF) for KDP or IngramSpark, an EPUB ebook and a paperback cover, from the chat. Ask in your own words: "format my book", "make an EPUB of my manuscript", "make my paperback cover" or "review my manuscript".

Bring in your manuscript (Word, text or Markdown) and ask for what you need:
- A print-ready interior PDF and an EPUB, laid out at your trim size and checked against KDP and IngramSpark rules before you get the files. The first pages appear in the chat.
- A paperback cover from your own art: the full wrap with spine and back copy, sized from your page count, with an ebook cover. It appears in the chat.
- An editorial review of the whole book: your assistant reads it chapter by chapter as Tunmire's editor and writes the editorial letter, and you get the report as a Word file. It reports; it never changes your words.
- A check of a PDF, EPUB or cover you already have against KDP and IngramSpark rules.

Connecting creates a Tunmire account, where your books are kept. Your work is yours: nothing you make is used to improve any AI, and finished files are built when you open their link, not kept.
